description: Implementation of a PDCCH resource allocator for 5G NR scheduling, including slot management, PDCCH allocation for downlink and uplink, and handling of search spaces and CORESET configurations.

classes.name: pdcch_resource_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implements the PDCCH resource allocation logic, managing slot records, search spaces, and PDCCH candidate selection for 5G NR.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the current slot and clears previous slot records.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates downlink PDCCH for common search spaces.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_common
methods.description: Allocates uplink PDCCH for common search spaces.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates downlink PDCCH for a specific UE.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_ue
methods.description: Allocates uplink PDCCH for a specific UE.

methods.name: alloc_ul_pdcch_helper
methods.description: Helper function to allocate uplink PDCCH with detailed parameters.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch_helper
methods.description: Helper function to allocate downlink PDCCH with detailed parameters.

methods.name: cancel_last_pdcch
methods.description: Cancels the last allocated PDCCH in a slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Resets the allocator state, clearing slot records.

methods.name: get_pdcch_slot_alloc
methods.description: Retrieves the slot allocator for a given slot point.
